segment.source: Renders the opening claim with a single-field capture row under it — one input, one button, and a line of small print for consent or a 'no card required' promise. Use it for: newsletter landing pages, waiting lists, free-trial starts, early-access campaigns, webinar registrations. Prefer 'Product Hero' when the action is a link to a signup page rather than a field on this one, and 'Search Hero' when the input queries the site instead of collecting an address.
